children: Definitive announced that certain TRA holders irrevocably waived their right to an Early Termination Payment for qualifying Change of Control transactions with definitive merger agreements executed on or before Dec. 31, 2026.

TRA holders representing Advent, Spectrum Equity, 22C Capital and Jason Krantz waived Early Termination Payment rights for Qualifying Change of Control events if merger agreement is signed by Dec 31, 2026.
Upon consummation of a Qualifying Change of Control, the TRA will terminate per its terms and TRA parties will take actions reasonably necessary to effect termination.
The waiver is limited; TRA holders' other rights, including tax benefit payments for taxable years ending prior to or including the transaction, remain unchanged.
Definitive is not a party to the waiver and furnished this disclosure under Item 7.01; the filing is furnished, not deemed filed, for certain Exchange Act purposes.
